description: Comment "Family" and I'll send you all the prompts 👇 What happens when you ask Claude to build your entire family tree and find relatives you didn't even know existed? I tried this and Claude found family members I didn't even know I was related to. Here's how: Prompt 1: "I want to build my full family tree. Interview me one question at a time about my full name, where my family is from, and every relative I can remember." Claude maps out everything you know into a clean tree. Prompt 2: "Based on my last name and where my family came from, trace the origin of my family line and tell me how far back you can go." Claude pulls the entire history behind your family name and some of it is genuinely wild. Here's the trick: Go to Connectors → Add Connectors → search Google Chrome → Connect. Prompt 3: "Use Chrome to search public records, ancestry databases, and obituaries to find relatives connected to my family that I don't already have. Give me the link to each one." Claude opens its own browser and comes back with relatives you never knew existed. Bonus prompt: "Now build me a full visual family tree with everyone you found and how we're all connected." Claude generates an artifact that lays out your entire bloodline. #claude #ai #claudeprompts #familytree #ancestry
